summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private path-resolution helper; exported it from monai/data/__init__.py; added the "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection after the Utilities entry in docs/source/data.rst; and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests, temp directories removed in finally). Per instructions, I did not run tests or black and did not commit. Line lengths were measured manually: all new and edited files are within 120 columns. The loader imports typing for the type hints in addition to os and json; that is the one judgment call to confirm.
